description: This header file declares the interface for the Rust implementation of KeyMint's main function (`kmr_ta_main`). It provides the function prototype for initializing and running the security environment component within the secure environment, including parameters for file descriptors, security level, resource manager pointer, and communication socket.

methods.name: kmr_ta_main
methods.description: Main function for Rust implementation of KeyMint, handling serialized request and response messages, security level advertisement, resource management, and secure environment communication.
